reviews.text: Come learn, come to daycare. Good place, with good trainers.
Great instructors, great atmosphere. Flexible team. They impart a lot of knowledge during their training. I wholeheartedly recommend them to hobby dog ​​owners.

Dear András! 
We are very sorry that you had a bad experience with us. Unfortunately, we searched in vain, but we could not find which of our courses you attended. In order for us to improve, the opinions of those who have already visited us are very important. Could you please write what you did not like about our school? Thank you!

Best dog school!!! I really like the variety of classes, the professionalism of the instructors, their problem-solving skills and the lots of good advice. I've been coming here with my dog ​​since Ovi ☺️
Dear Martini! Thank you very much for your review! 💚🐾 …
We have been going here for years to school, obedience training, dog training courses and seminars, we love it. 🥰 …
Very professional team! We are full-time daycare workers, but we have also completed several courses at the school. We have even tried swimming and used the boarding house.
Experienced, well-trained instructors, I can recommend them to all dog owners🫶🏽 …

I have had very good experiences with Akela Dog School. The classes are well structured, the atmosphere is friendly.
All the trainers are very professional, but I would like to especially highlight Szandra Kovács, who is an extremely patient and knowledgeable trainer. She understands dog behavior very well and always gives useful, practical advice. I highly recommend her to everyone!

The best dog school I have ever come across. Professional, helpful team, lots of help and advice not only during the school period. Very professional and professional training with great patience towards novice owners. I can only recommend it to everyone. I am very happy that I found them.
I took 2 courses a year and a half ago, and since then I can always turn to them for help with any problems/questions. The trainers are helpful, kind, and my dog ​​enjoyed the sessions.

We have been to many schools, but Akela is by far the best! The instructors have a huge amount of professional knowledge, they answer all questions kindly and willingly, they understand different breeds very well and are infinitely kind to all owners! Choosing them was the best decision we made!!!
